print()

print()

print()

print(f"Avg Calories Burned: {df['calories_burned'].mean():.1f}")

print()

df['has_workout'] = df['workout_type'].notna()

print(f"Non-workout rows (NaN): {df['workout_type'].isna().sum()} = {df['workout_type'].isna().mean()*100:.1f}%")
print()

# By gender
for g in ['Male', 'Female']:
    sub = df[df['gender'] == g]
    rate = sub['workout_type'].notna().mean() * 100
    print(f"  {g} workout participation: {rate:.1f}%")
print()

print("=== TEMPORAL ANALYSIS ===")
df['year'] = df['date'].dt.year
df['month'] = df['date'].dt.month
df['month_name'] = df['date'].dt.strftime('%b')
df['dow'] = df['date'].dt.dayofweek
df['dow_name'] = df['date'].dt.strftime('%a')

print("--- Steps by Year ---")
yearly = df.groupby('year').agg(
    steps=('steps','mean'),
    calories=('calories_burned','mean'),
    sleep=('sleep_hours','mean'),
    stress=('stress_level','mean'),
    heart_rate=('heart_rate_avg','mean'),
    water=('water_intake_liters','mean'),
    records=('steps','count')
).round(1)
print(yearly)
print()

print("--- Steps by Month (across all years) ---")
monthly = df.groupby('month').agg(
    steps=('steps','mean'),
    sleep=('sleep_hours','mean'),
    stress=('stress_level','mean'),
    calories=('calories_burned','mean')
).round(1)
print(monthly)
print()

print("--- Steps by Day of Week ---")
dow = df.groupby('dow').agg(
    steps=('steps','mean'),
    sleep=('sleep_hours','mean'),

).round(1)
dow['day'] = ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun']
print(dow)
print()

for yr in sorted(df['year'].unique()):

print()

    steps=('steps','mean'),
    calories=('calories_burned','mean'),

print()

print()

print()
